summary: Brantley County tower listed with an elevation of 82 (no unit given) in a 2016 Georgia lookout list; no other source found describes the tower or the site today.

evidence.supports: listed as fendig in Brantley County at 31.33780, -81.83887, elevation 82
the list was last revised in March 2016
the list draws on USGS name databases and topographic maps
evidence.quote: Map shows GA fire towers listed by USGS name database (1-72) and as discovered

evidence.supports: the list draws on 1:100,000 USGS topographic maps as well as the name database
evidence.quote: on 1:100,000 USGS topo maps and NGS

notes_for_editor: Thinnest of the three. Only the 2016 list entry supports anything. Two web searches turned up no tower source; the Wikipedia page for Fendig, Georgia returns 404. The story is about 70 words, far under the 120-word floor, and is kept short rather than padded. Recommend holding it or keeping it as a stub. The list gives no elevation unit; feet is only inferred from the list's other values, such as Brasstown Lookout Tower at 4735, so the story flags feet as an assumption. Brantley County had the April 2026 Highway 82 Fire (news reports), but no source places this tower in its path, so the fire is not mentioned.
